body:
## Summary
- Reconstructed the Building-map failure from the latest owner log (`game_log_20260416_193750.txt`): enemies entered `PURSUING` frequently, ran hundreds of corner checks, and only a few far/off-screen enemies reached `FLANKING`.
- Added an early `PURSUING` priority path: when the player is visible, within `PURSUIT_FLANK_PRIORITY_DISTANCE` (900px), and still unhittable, the enemy attempts `FLANKING` before existing pursuit-cover movement, cover waiting, or another pursuit-cover search can return.
- Moved flank target/side selection into `EnemyFlankNavigationHelper`, keeping `scripts/objects/enemy.gd` below the 5000-line architecture limit.
- Preserved the issue logs, latest PR metadata, and screenshots under `docs/case-studies/issue-1814/`, and updated the case study with the final distance/ordering root cause.

## Case Study Evidence
Latest Building screenshot bundle preserved in the branch:

![Issue 1814 screenshot 1](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/images/issue-1814-screenshot-1.png?raw=true)

![Issue 1814 screenshot 2](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/images/issue-1814-screenshot-2.png?raw=true)

![Issue 1814 screenshot 3](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-godot-topdown-MVP/blob/issue-1814-67b54615dfb8/docs/case-studies/issue-1814/images/issue-1814-screenshot-3.png?raw=true)

## Verification
- `git diff --check`
- Architecture line-count check: `scripts/objects/enemy.gd` is now 4932 lines, below the 5000-line CI limit.
- `dotnet build GodotTopDownTemplate.sln --configuration Debug` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
- Targeted GUT run: `Godot_v4.3-stable_mono_linux.x86_64 --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gtest=res://tests/unit/test_enemy.gd -gunit_test_name=pursuit -gexit -glog=2` reported 33/33 pursuit tests passing.
- Full local GUT remains noisy in this workspace because unrelated existing project/test import and parse warnings are emitted before/around the selected tests; the targeted pursuit suite itself passed.



Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1814
